+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    const size_t matrix_elements = count * count;
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_members(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<BestResult> device_best(1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          count * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrixKernel<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    cudaFuncAttributes shared_kernel_attributes{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&shared_kernel_attributes,
+                                     candidateCardinalitySharedKernel));
+    int device = 0;
+    int opt_in_shared_bytes = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&opt_in_shared_bytes,
+                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin,
+                                      device));
+    // Leave a small alignment reserve because the reported opt-in limit also
+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.
+    const int max_dynamic_shared_bytes = std::max(
+        0, opt_in_shared_bytes -
+            static_cast<int>(shared_kernel_attributes.sharedSizeBytes) - 256);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
+        candidateCardinalitySharedKernel,
+        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
+        max_dynamic_shared_bytes));
+    const int shared_state_capacity = std::max(

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the

+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,

+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);

+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);

+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.

+            static_cast<int>(shared_kernel_attributes.sharedSizeBytes) - 256);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(

+__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult chooseLarger(const BestResult a,
+                                                   const BestResult b) {

+__global__ void bestSeedKernel(const int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                               const int active_count,
+                               BestResult* __restrict__ result) {
+    BestResult local{-1, INT_MAX};

+        local = chooseLarger(local, BestResult{cardinalities[slot], slot});

+        warp_slots[warp] = local.seed_slot;

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_members(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<BestResult> device_best(1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          count * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);

+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&shared_kernel_attributes,
+                                     candidateCardinalitySharedKernel));
+    int device = 0;

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&opt_in_shared_bytes,
+                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin,

+    // Leave a small alignment reserve because the reported opt-in limit also
+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.
+    const int max_dynamic_shared_bytes = std::max(

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(

+    const int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);

+__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult chooseLarger(const BestResult a,
+                                                   const BestResult b) {
+    return (b.cardinality > a.cardinality ||
+            (b.cardinality == a.cardinality && b.seed_slot < a.seed_slot))
+        ? b : a;

+__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult warpMaximum(BestResult value) {
+    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+        BestResult other;
+        other.cardinality =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value.cardinality, offset);
+        other.seed_slot =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value.seed_slot, offset);
+        value = chooseLarger(value, other);
+    }
+    return value;

+                               const int active_count,

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    const size_t matrix_elements = count * count;
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_members(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<BestResult> device_best(1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          count * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrixKernel<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    cudaFuncAttributes shared_kernel_attributes{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&shared_kernel_attributes,
+                                     candidateCardinalitySharedKernel));
+    int device = 0;
+    int opt_in_shared_bytes = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&opt_in_shared_bytes,
+                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin,
+                                      device));
+    // Leave a small alignment reserve because the reported opt-in limit also
+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.
+    const int max_dynamic_shared_bytes = std::max(
+        0, opt_in_shared_bytes -
+            static_cast<int>(shared_kernel_attributes.sharedSizeBytes) - 256);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
+        candidateCardinalitySharedKernel,
+        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
+        max_dynamic_shared_bytes));
+    const int shared_state_capacity = std::max(
+        1, max_dynamic_shared_bytes / static_cast<int>(sizeof(double)));
+
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_global_state;
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_sequences;
+    if (point_count > shared_state_capacity) {
+        device_global_state.allocate(matrix_elements);
+    } else {

+        // cluster.  This is bounded to the shared-memory path, where the extra
+        // matrix is modest and the saved kernel launches matter most.

+        const int candidate_block_size = candidateBlockSize(active_count);

+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+            device_sequences.get() != nullptr) {
+            const size_t shared_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(double);
+            candidateCardinalitySharedKernel<<<active_count, candidate_block_size,
+                                               shared_bytes>>>(

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    const size_t matrix_elements = count * count;
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_members(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<BestResult> device_best(1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          count * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrixKernel<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    cudaFuncAttributes shared_kernel_attributes{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&shared_kernel_attributes,
+                                     candidateCardinalitySharedKernel));
+    int device = 0;
+    int opt_in_shared_bytes = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&opt_in_shared_bytes,
+                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin,
+                                      device));
+    // Leave a small alignment reserve because the reported opt-in limit also
+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.
+    const int max_dynamic_shared_bytes = std::max(
+        0, opt_in_shared_bytes -
+            static_cast<int>(shared_kernel_attributes.sharedSizeBytes) - 256);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
+        candidateCardinalitySharedKernel,
+        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
+        max_dynamic_shared_bytes));
+    const int shared_state_capacity = std::max(
+        1, max_dynamic_shared_bytes / static_cast<int>(sizeof(double)));
+
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_global_state;
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_sequences;
+    if (point_count > shared_state_capacity) {
+        device_global_state.allocate(matrix_elements);
+    } else {
+        // Recording all seed sequences avoids serially rebuilding the winning
+        // cluster.  This is bounded to the shared-memory path, where the extra
+        // matrix is modest and the saved kernel launches matter most.
+        device_sequences.allocate(matrix_elements);

+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> selected_members;
+
+    while (!active.empty()) {
+        const int active_count = static_cast<int>(active.size());
+        const int candidate_block_size = candidateBlockSize(active_count);
+        const size_t active_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(int);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active.get(), active.data(), active_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+

+            device_sequences.get() != nullptr) {
+            const size_t shared_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(double);
+            candidateCardinalitySharedKernel<<<active_count, candidate_block_size,
+                                               shared_bytes>>>(
+                device_distances.get(), device_active.get(),

+__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult chooseLarger(const BestResult a,
+                                                   const BestResult b) {
+    return (b.cardinality > a.cardinality ||
+            (b.cardinality == a.cardinality && b.seed_slot < a.seed_slot))
+        ? b : a;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult warpMaximum(BestResult value) {
+    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+        BestResult other;
+        other.cardinality =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value.cardinality, offset);
+        other.seed_slot =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value.seed_slot, offset);
+        value = chooseLarger(value, other);
+    }
+    return value;
+}

+__global__ void bestSeedKernel(const int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                               const int active_count,
+                               BestResult* __restrict__ result) {
+    BestResult local{-1, INT_MAX};
+    for (int slot = threadIdx.x; slot < active_count; slot += blockDim.x) {
+        local = chooseLarger(local, BestResult{cardinalities[slot], slot});
+    }
+    local = warpMaximum(local);
+
+    __shared__ int warp_cardinalities[32];
+    __shared__ int warp_slots[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (warpSize - 1);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / warpSize;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warp_cardinalities[warp] = local.cardinality;
+        warp_slots[warp] = local.seed_slot;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const int warp_count = (blockDim.x + warpSize - 1) / warpSize;
+        BestResult block_value = lane < warp_count
+            ? BestResult{warp_cardinalities[lane], warp_slots[lane]}
+            : BestResult{-1, INT_MAX};
+        block_value = warpMaximum(block_value);
+        if (lane == 0) *result = block_value;
+    }

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    const size_t matrix_elements = count * count;
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_members(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<BestResult> device_best(1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          count * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrixKernel<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    cudaFuncAttributes shared_kernel_attributes{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&shared_kernel_attributes,
+                                     candidateCardinalitySharedKernel));
+    int device = 0;
+    int opt_in_shared_bytes = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&opt_in_shared_bytes,
+                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin,
+                                      device));
+    // Leave a small alignment reserve because the reported opt-in limit also
+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.
+    const int max_dynamic_shared_bytes = std::max(
+        0, opt_in_shared_bytes -
+            static_cast<int>(shared_kernel_attributes.sharedSizeBytes) - 256);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
+        candidateCardinalitySharedKernel,
+        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
+        max_dynamic_shared_bytes));
+    const int shared_state_capacity = std::max(
+        1, max_dynamic_shared_bytes / static_cast<int>(sizeof(double)));
+
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_global_state;
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_sequences;
+    if (point_count > shared_state_capacity) {
+        device_global_state.allocate(matrix_elements);
+    } else {
+        // Recording all seed sequences avoids serially rebuilding the winning
+        // cluster.  This is bounded to the shared-memory path, where the extra
+        // matrix is modest and the saved kernel launches matter most.
+        device_sequences.allocate(matrix_elements);
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> active(count);
+    std::iota(active.begin(), active.end(), 0);
+    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(count, 0);
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> selected_members;
+
+    while (!active.empty()) {
+        const int active_count = static_cast<int>(active.size());
+        const int candidate_block_size = candidateBlockSize(active_count);
+        const size_t active_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(int);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active.get(), active.data(), active_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+

+            device_sequences.get() != nullptr) {
+            const size_t shared_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(double);
+            candidateCardinalitySharedKernel<<<active_count, candidate_block_size,
+                                               shared_bytes>>>(
+                device_distances.get(), device_active.get(),
+                device_cardinalities.get(), device_sequences.get(),

+__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult chooseLarger(const BestResult a,
+                                                   const BestResult b) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult warpMaximum(BestResult value) {

+        BestResult other;

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    const size_t matrix_elements = count * count;
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_members(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<BestResult> device_best(1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          count * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrixKernel<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    cudaFuncAttributes shared_kernel_attributes{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&shared_kernel_attributes,
+                                     candidateCardinalitySharedKernel));
+    int device = 0;
+    int opt_in_shared_bytes = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&opt_in_shared_bytes,
+                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin,
+                                      device));
+    // Leave a small alignment reserve because the reported opt-in limit also
+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.
+    const int max_dynamic_shared_bytes = std::max(
+        0, opt_in_shared_bytes -
+            static_cast<int>(shared_kernel_attributes.sharedSizeBytes) - 256);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
+        candidateCardinalitySharedKernel,
+        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
+        max_dynamic_shared_bytes));
+    const int shared_state_capacity = std::max(
+        1, max_dynamic_shared_bytes / static_cast<int>(sizeof(double)));
+
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_global_state;
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_sequences;
+    if (point_count > shared_state_capacity) {
+        device_global_state.allocate(matrix_elements);
+    } else {
+        // Recording all seed sequences avoids serially rebuilding the winning
+        // cluster.  This is bounded to the shared-memory path, where the extra
+        // matrix is modest and the saved kernel launches matter most.
+        device_sequences.allocate(matrix_elements);
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> active(count);
+    std::iota(active.begin(), active.end(), 0);
+    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(count, 0);
+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> selected_members;
+
+    while (!active.empty()) {
+        const int active_count = static_cast<int>(active.size());
+        const int candidate_block_size = candidateBlockSize(active_count);
+        const size_t active_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(int);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active.get(), active.data(), active_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+        if (active_count <= shared_state_capacity &&
+            device_sequences.get() != nullptr) {
+            const size_t shared_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(double);
+            candidateCardinalitySharedKernel<<<active_count, candidate_block_size,
+                                               shared_bytes>>>(
+                device_distances.get(), device_active.get(),
+                device_cardinalities.get(), device_sequences.get(),
+                point_count, active_count, threshold);
         } else {
-            // No more clusters can be formed

    88	int candidateBlockSize(const int active_count) {
    89	    // Smaller blocks schedule more independent seeds concurrently for the
    90	    // common benchmark sizes; larger active sets benefit from more threads
    91	    // cooperating on each candidate scan.
    92	    return active_count <= 1024 ? 128 : 256;

   198	__global__ void buildDistanceMatrixKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,
   199	                                          double* __restrict__ distances,
   200	                                          const int point_count) {
   201	    const int column = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x);
   202	    const int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y);
   203	    if (row >= point_count || column >= point_count) return;
   204	
   205	    const Point a = points[row];
   206	    const Point b = points[column];
   207	    const double dx = a.x - b.x;
   208	    const double dy = a.y - b.y;
   209	    distances[static_cast<size_t>(row) * point_count + column] =
   210	        sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   211	}

   213	// One block grows one seed cluster.  Every candidate's running maximum
   214	// distance is retained in shared memory, eliminating the sequential code's
   215	// repeated scan over all existing members.
   216	__global__ void candidateCardinalitySharedKernel(
   217	    const double* __restrict__ distances, const int* __restrict__ active,
   218	    int* __restrict__ cardinalities, int* __restrict__ sequences,
   219	    const int point_count, const int active_count, const double threshold) {
   220	    const int seed_slot = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
   221	    if (seed_slot >= active_count) return;
   222	
   223	    extern __shared__ double max_distances[];
   224	    __shared__ double warp_values[32];
   225	    __shared__ int warp_indices[32];
   226	    __shared__ int selected_slot;
   227	
   228	    const int seed = active[seed_slot];
   229	    int* const sequence = sequences == nullptr
   230	        ? nullptr
   231	        : sequences + static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count;
   232	    for (int slot = threadIdx.x; slot < active_count; slot += blockDim.x) {
   233	        max_distances[slot] = slot == seed_slot
   234	            ? DBL_MAX
   235	            : distances[static_cast<size_t>(seed) * point_count + active[slot]];
   236	    }
   237	    if (threadIdx.x == 0 && sequence != nullptr) sequence[0] = seed;
   238	    __syncthreads();
   239	
   240	    int cardinality = 1;
   241	    while (cardinality < active_count) {
   242	        const int selected = findClosestSlot(max_distances, active_count,
   243	                                             threshold, warp_values,
   244	                                             warp_indices, &selected_slot);
   245	        if (selected == INT_MAX) break;
   246	
   247	        const int selected_point = active[selected];
   248	        if (threadIdx.x == 0 && sequence != nullptr) {
   249	            sequence[cardinality] = selected_point;
   250	        }
   251	        ++cardinality;
   252	        for (int slot = threadIdx.x; slot < active_count; slot += blockDim.x) {
   253	            if (slot == selected) {
   254	                max_distances[slot] = DBL_MAX;
   255	            } else {
   256	                const double next = distances[
   257	                    static_cast<size_t>(selected_point) * point_count + active[slot]];
   258	                const double current = max_distances[slot];
   259	                max_distances[slot] = current < next ? next : current;
   260	            }
   261	        }
   262	        __syncthreads();
   263	    }
   264	
   265	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardinalities[seed_slot] = cardinality;
   266	}

   316	__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult chooseLarger(const BestResult a,
   317	                                                   const BestResult b) {
   318	    return (b.cardinality > a.cardinality ||
   319	            (b.cardinality == a.cardinality && b.seed_slot < a.seed_slot))
   320	        ? b : a;
   321	}

   323	__device__ __forceinline__ BestResult warpMaximum(BestResult value) {
   324	    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   325	        BestResult other;
   326	        other.cardinality =
   327	            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value.cardinality, offset);
   328	        other.seed_slot =
   329	            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value.seed_slot, offset);
   330	        value = chooseLarger(value, other);
   390	        ++cardinality;

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    const size_t matrix_elements = count * count;
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_members(count);

Implemented unconditional CUDA parallelization while preserving the `qtclustering` executable name.

Key changes:

- One CUDA block evaluates each seed concurrently.
- Deterministic warp/block reductions preserve sequential tie-breaking.
- GPU-resident pairwise distance matrix and incremental diameter updates.
- Shared-memory fast path with opt-in capacity and global-memory fallback.
- Adaptive block sizing and singleton-tail optimization.
- Native CUDA architecture generation and optimized compilation in [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r4/qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt:1).
- CUDA implementation in [qtclustering.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r4/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:198).

Verification:

- Clean CMake/CUDA build succeeded.
- Exact reference membership hashes matched across multiple sizes and thresholds.
- Validation passed at 64, 100, 300, and 1,000 points.
- 1,000 points: approximately 7.05 seconds sequential versus 12.36 ms measured CUDA clustering.
- 8,000 points: approximately 2.84 seconds CUDA clustering.
- Only the two existing files were changed.

+    __shared__ int warp_slots[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (warpSize - 1);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / warpSize;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warp_cardinalities[warp] = local.cardinality;
+        warp_slots[warp] = local.seed_slot;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();

+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const int warp_count = (blockDim.x + warpSize - 1) / warpSize;
+        BestResult block_value = lane < warp_count

+            : BestResult{-1, INT_MAX};
+        block_value = warpMaximum(block_value);
+        if (lane == 0) *result = block_value;
+    }

+__global__ void reconstructGlobalKernel(
+    const double* __restrict__ distances, const int* __restrict__ active,
+    double* __restrict__ max_distances, int* __restrict__ members,
+    const int point_count, const int active_count, const int seed_slot,
+    const double threshold) {
+    __shared__ double warp_values[32];
+    __shared__ int warp_indices[32];
+    __shared__ int selected_slot;

+    const int seed = active[seed_slot];

+        max_distances[slot] = slot == seed_slot

+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[0] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();

+    int cardinality = 1;
+    while (cardinality < active_count) {

+                                             threshold, warp_values,

+        if (selected == INT_MAX) break;
+        const int selected_point = active[selected];
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[cardinality] = selected_point;
+        ++cardinality;
+
+        for (int slot = threadIdx.x; slot < active_count; slot += blockDim.x) {
+            if (slot == selected) {
+                max_distances[slot] = DBL_MAX;
+            } else {
+                const double next = distances[
+                    static_cast<size_t>(selected_point) * point_count + active[slot]];
+                const double current = max_distances[slot];
+                max_distances[slot] = current < next ? next : current;
             }

-            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list

-                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),
-                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),
-                unclustered_indices.end()
-            );
+        }

+    }

+// Main QT clustering algorithm.  Candidate seeds are always evaluated on the
+// GPU; there is deliberately no sequential clustering fallback.
+std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
+                                  const double threshold) {
+    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
+    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(point_count);
+    if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / count ||
+        count * count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "Point count is too large for the distance matrix\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    const size_t matrix_elements = count * count;
+
+    DeviceBuffer<Point> device_points(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<double> device_distances(matrix_elements);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_active(count);
+    DeviceBuffer<int> device_cardinalities(count);

+    DeviceBuffer<BestResult> device_best(1);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points.get(), points.data(),
+                          count * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    const dim3 distance_block(32, 8);
+    const dim3 distance_grid(
+        (point_count + distance_block.x - 1) / distance_block.x,
+        (point_count + distance_block.y - 1) / distance_block.y);
+    buildDistanceMatrixKernel<<<distance_grid, distance_block>>>(
+        device_points.get(), device_distances.get(), point_count);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+    cudaFuncAttributes shared_kernel_attributes{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&shared_kernel_attributes,
+                                     candidateCardinalitySharedKernel));
+    int device = 0;
+    int opt_in_shared_bytes = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&opt_in_shared_bytes,
+                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlockOptin,

+    // Leave a small alignment reserve because the reported opt-in limit also
+    // includes the kernel's statically allocated reduction scratch space.
+    const int max_dynamic_shared_bytes = std::max(
+        0, opt_in_shared_bytes -
+            static_cast<int>(shared_kernel_attributes.sharedSizeBytes) - 256);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(
+        candidateCardinalitySharedKernel,
+        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,
+        max_dynamic_shared_bytes));
+    const int shared_state_capacity = std::max(
+        1, max_dynamic_shared_bytes / static_cast<int>(sizeof(double)));

+    } else {

+        // cluster.  This is bounded to the shared-memory path, where the extra
+        // matrix is modest and the saved kernel launches matter most.
+        device_sequences.allocate(matrix_elements);
+    }

+    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
+    std::vector<int> selected_members;
+
+    while (!active.empty()) {

+        const int candidate_block_size = candidateBlockSize(active_count);
+        const size_t active_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(int);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active.get(), active.data(), active_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+

+            device_sequences.get() != nullptr) {
+            const size_t shared_bytes = active.size() * sizeof(double);
+            candidateCardinalitySharedKernel<<<active_count, candidate_block_size,
+                                               shared_bytes>>>(
+                device_distances.get(), device_active.get(),
+                device_cardinalities.get(), device_sequences.get(),
+                point_count, active_count, threshold);

-            // No more clusters can be formed

+                device_distances.get(), device_active.get(),
+                device_global_state.get(), device_cardinalities.get(),
+                point_count, active_count, threshold);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        bestSeedKernel<<<1, CUDA_REDUCTION_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device_cardinalities.get(), active_count, device_best.get());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        BestResult best{};
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&best, device_best.get(), sizeof(best),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        // If every candidate is a singleton, all future iterations are fixed:
+        // the sequential algorithm emits the remaining points in index order.
+        if (best.cardinality == 1) {
+            clusters.reserve(clusters.size() + active.size());
+            for (const int point : active) {

+                                  selected_members.size() * sizeof(int),

Implemented unconditional CUDA parallelization while preserving the `qtclustering` executable name.

Key changes:

- One CUDA block evaluates each seed concurrently.
- Deterministic warp/block reductions preserve sequential tie-breaking.
- GPU-resident pairwise distance matrix and incremental diameter updates.
- Shared-memory fast path with opt-in capacity and global-memory fallback.
- Adaptive block sizing and singleton-tail optimization.
- Native CUDA architecture generation and optimized compilation in [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r4/qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt:1).
- CUDA implementation in [qtclustering.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r4/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:198).
